title.en: The German-Type Mortar Order Is 7.5/9 kW, Not the 5 m³/h Hydraulic Sprayer
title.zh: 德式砂浆订单是 7.5/9 kW，不是 5 m³/h 液压喷涂机

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the German-type mortar sprayer at 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa and particle ≤5 mm. The hydraulic concrete sprayer prints 5 m³/h and ≤8 mm on a different page.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把德式砂浆喷涂机印成 7.5/9 kW、3–5 m³/h、8 MPa、粒径 ≤5 mm。液压混凝土喷涂机在另一页印 5 m³/h 和 ≤8 mm。

h1.en: Order the German-Type Page by Particle ≤5 mm
h1.zh: 按粒径 ≤5 mm 订德式页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the German-type mortar spraying machine at 380 V, motors 7.5/9 kW, all-copper dual motor, output 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, particle ≤5 mm, 40 m / 20 m, 1700 × 650 × 800 mm and 360 kg. The 5 m³/h hydraulic page prints 7.5/9 kW as well, but particle ≤8 mm, hose 38/51 mm and 100 m / 50 m. Same motor numbers do not make one order. If the particle cell you need is ≤5 mm and the distance is 40 m / 20 m, open the German-type path. It is quote-only. Send it to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把德式砂浆喷涂机印成 380 V、电机 7.5/9 kW、全铜双电机、输送量 3–5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、粒径 ≤5 mm、40 m / 20 m、1700 × 650 × 800 mm、360 kg。5 m³/h 的液压页也印 7.5/9 kW，但粒径是 ≤8 mm，软管 38/51 mm，距离 100 m / 50 m。电机数字相同不是一张订单。如果你需要的粒径格是 ≤5 mm、距离是 40 m / 20 m，请打开德式路径。该页只询价。发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

heading.en: 360 kg is also on Type 511 diesel
heading.zh: 360 kg 也在 511 柴油机上

body.en: Type 511 diesel prints 360 kg with 3 m³/h and ≤6 mm, and it does not print 7.5/9 kW. Weight does not choose the German-type page.
body.zh: 511 柴油机印 360 kg、3 m³/h、≤6 mm，并且不印 7.5/9 kW。重量选不出德式页。

body.en: 8 MPa on this sprayer is not Diesel 30’s 20 MPa trailer cell.
body.zh: 这台喷涂机上的 8 MPa 不是柴油30拖泵的 20 MPa。

body.en: Keep 3–5 m³/h. Do not replace it with the hydraulic page’s single 5 m³/h.
body.zh: 保留 3–5 m³/h。不要用液压页的单个 5 m³/h 替换。

question.zh: 这一页需要 380 V 吗？

answer.en: No. ≤5 mm. ≤8 mm is the hydraulic concrete sprayer.
answer.zh: 不是。是 ≤5 mm。≤8 mm 是液压混凝土喷涂机。

answer.en: No. It is a mortar spraying machine.

alt.en: German-type mortar spraying machine manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai manufacturer
alt.zh: 德式砂浆喷涂机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
